scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: Homework at Nani's desk
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. After school she goes to Nani's house. Today they sit at Nani's desk, and Nani helps her with Hindi homework, one tricky word at a time. Nani's phone lies on the desk beside her glasses. Tara has just finished the last question when the phone rings.
scenes.dialogue: Done! Nani, you're the best teacher!

scenes.label: The bank call
scenes.title: “Read me the OTP.”
scenes.caption: A man says he's a bank officer. Nani's card will be blocked today, he says, unless she reads out the OTP that just arrived. A message pops up with a six-digit code. Nani looks worried and starts to read it aloud. Tara gasps: Nani, wait!
scenes.speech: A man says he's a bank officer. Nani's card will be blocked today, he says, unless she reads out the O T P that just arrived. A message pops up with a six-digit code. Nani looks worried and starts to read it aloud. Tara gasps: Nani, wait!
scenes.dialogue: Nani, wait! Don't read that code!

scenes.label: Spot the pattern
scenes.title: Same trick, different title
scenes.caption: Nani puts the phone down. Then it rings again, and a second caller says the electricity office will cut her power tonight unless she shares a code. Tara spots the pattern: an important-sounding title, a rush, and a request for the OTP, the one-time password that approves payments and sign-ins.

scenes.label: Answer safely
scenes.title: Help Nani answer both calls.
scenes.caption: Your turn. Both callers are still trying. For each pretend call, choose the safe response with Nani. Think about who you'd really be talking to. Take your time. Careful: sharing the OTP, even to verify, is exactly what the caller wants.

scenes.label: The OTP rule
scenes.title: Your OTP is yours alone.
scenes.caption: A real bank, electricity office or courier never asks for your OTP or PIN on a call. Hang up, then call the number printed on your card, bill or official app yourself. Tell a family member. If money is ever lost, call 1930 quickly and report at cybercrime.gov.in.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Nani's OTP guardian
scenes.caption: Nani calls the number on the back of her card. Her card is fine! The electricity bill is already paid. That evening they tell Mum everything, and Mum hugs them both. Nani laughs: my granddaughter, the OTP guardian! Your turn: help Tara spot more risky calls and keep codes private!
